summary: The module 5 checkpoint. You make real-mode calls retry (with a test), score the weak prompt first, then the better one, on five fixed questions with mechanical checks, read the failures to find whether the cause is the prompt, the search or the model, try one change, and write the before and after note.
goal: Make real-mode calls retry, and show a before and after score for a rewritten prompt on five questions.

items.text: Part A: score the weak prompt on the five questions before you change anything
Part B: wrap the real client in the retrying client and write two tests
Part C: check the better prompt for rules you can check and for leaked test questions
Part D: write compare_prompts.py and match the simulated table, with tests passing and mypy clean
Parts E and F: run it with a real model, read the first failure and try one change
Parts G and H: write the before and after note, update the README, commit and push
Play the Before and After game to the end and see your score
